Subject: Network demarcation request for SOC 2 / SIG review — Acme Private deployment

Hi Kimberly,

Thanks again for the quick sync earlier. To keep the SOC 2 / SIG review moving I need a compact set of artifacts that explain how Redwood’s Private/Dedicated deployment is demarcated from customer VPCs and from other tenants. Specifically the reviewer asked for:

- An annotated network diagram showing logical vs physical demarcation (control plane, data plane, management).
- A short table/matrix that maps controls to traffic flows (e.g., control-plane management port ranges, egress filters, NAT/egress gateways).
- Confirmation of where KMS/HSM boundary lives and whether customer keys ever traverse Redwood control plane.
- Evidence of egress filtering and least-privilege routing (sample ACLs or snips).

Can we get these assets by EOD Friday (2027-05-21)? Our audit window opens next week. If you have a single zip with the items, please include an index.txt that maps files to SIG/Catalog questions.

Thanks,
Daniel Park
Senior Security Engineer — Acme Corp
Audit team

Hi Daniel —

Acknowledged. We'll assemble a concise package that covers each bullet. Quick clarifying questions so we scope precisely:

1) For the annotated diagram — do you prefer a single page SVG (logical overlays) plus a separate physical-hosting page, or a single multi-layer diagram? We can provide both but want to know if reviewers must sign off on diagrams embedded in the SIG questionnaire.
2) For KMS detail — do you need key lifecycle documentation (rotation/backup) or just boundaries (where keys are stored, who can unwrap)?
3) For ACLs — we will redact customer IPs. Is a representative snippet sufficient or do you need full rule tables?

Plan: Michael will produce the isolation matrix and ACL snippets, Marissa will prepare the diagrams and index, and I will curate the zip and add an index that maps to SIG/Catalog controls. Target: delivery by close-of-business Friday (2027-05-21) as requested.

Initial checklist attached.

Best,

I'll tidy up the CSV with column descriptions and drop in sample pcap fingerprints if the auditor wants traffic proof.
